name: Training Design
description: Design and build a facilitator-ready training pack: an audience profile and measurable learning objectives, a timed agenda, module content, a slide outline, exercises and case studies, a facilitator guide, and an assessment. The mission supplies the subject and audience; the methodology supplies the shape of a professional one-day course.
principles: Start from what the learner must be able to DO, not from what to cover.
Every module maps to a stated learning objective.
Adults learn by doing: pair every concept with practice.
Time the day realistically; an agenda that cannot fit the clock is fiction.
A course a facilitator cannot run from the guide is not finished.

stages.name: Design
stages.description: Decide who the training is for, what they must be able to do by the end, and how the day is shaped to get them there.

quality_gate.description: Design is complete when the audience, measurable learning objectives, and a timed agenda are all in place.

deliverables.name: Training Plan
deliverables.description: The audience, the learning objectives, and a realistic timed agenda for the day.

activities.name: Profile the audience
activities.description: Describe who attends: their role, current level, and what they need to be able to do afterwards.

activities.name: Define learning objectives
activities.description: Write measurable learning objectives, each an observable thing the learner can do by the end of the day.

activities.name: Design the agenda
activities.description: Lay out a timed agenda for a full day, mapping each block to a learning objective, with breaks and realistic durations.

stages.name: Build
stages.description: Produce the teaching material: the content of each module, the slides that carry it, and the exercises that make it stick.

quality_gate.description: Build is complete when the modules, a slide outline, and hands-on exercises all exist.

deliverables.name: Module Content
deliverables.description: The substance of the training: each module's teaching content, worked examples, and key takeaways, in the order the agenda runs.

activities.name: Write the module content
activities.description: For each agenda block, write the teaching content: concepts, worked examples, and the key takeaways the learner leaves with.

deliverables.name: Slide Deck Outline
deliverables.description: A slide-by-slide outline of the deck that carries the modules, with the point each slide makes and its speaker note.

activities.name: Outline the slide deck
activities.description: Produce a slide-by-slide outline: for each slide give its title, the single point it makes, and a speaker note. Keep slides sparse.

deliverables.name: Exercises and Case Studies
deliverables.description: Hands-on practice: exercises and a running case study that make learners apply each objective, with model answers.

activities.name: Design the exercises
activities.description: Create exercises and a running case study that make learners practise each objective, each with instructions, timing, and a model answer.

stages.name: Package
stages.description: Turn the material into something a facilitator can run and a sponsor can measure.

quality_gate.description: Packaging is complete when a facilitator could run the day from the guide and the learning can be assessed.

deliverables.name: Facilitator Guide
deliverables.description: The run-sheet a trainer follows: what to do and say in each block, timings, transitions, and facilitation tips.

activities.name: Write the facilitator guide
activities.description: Write a block-by-block run sheet a facilitator can deliver from: what to cover, how long it takes, how to run each exercise, and tips for common difficulties.

deliverables.name: Assessment and Feedback
deliverables.description: How you know the training worked: a knowledge check against the objectives and a feedback form.

activities.name: Design the assessment
activities.description: Create a short knowledge check mapped to the learning objectives, plus an end-of-day feedback form.
